data.body:
> A bowerbird doesn't build its display once. It keeps it, every day, one blue feather at a time.

## This page is the proof

An AI assistant built this site from the public install guide and keeps it up to date. No one wrote code for it. Every change you see here was approved by its owner with a passkey before it went live.

## Say it out loud

Tell your assistant: *Set up Porchsite from porchsite.dev.* It sets up the site on your own Cloudflare account, one step at a time, and asks you only for what it can't do itself.

After that you talk, it writes. A trip, a project, a photo from your phone: your assistant drafts the page and sends you a link to approve.

## What it is instead of

- **A website builder** — you drag boxes around, then stop updating it
- **A blog platform** — another login, another editor, another thing to remember
- **Paying a developer** — every change is an email and an invoice
- **Letting an AI publish for you** — fast, until it posts something you never saw

Porchsite does one thing: it lets your assistant keep your site, and keeps you in charge of what goes live.

data.title: How it works
data.summary: From one sentence to a live site, and what happens after.
data.body:
## 1. Install

Your assistant follows the install guide at porchsite.dev. Every step is one call to Cloudflare. No git, no terminal.

## 2. Claim it

You open your new site once and save a passkey. From then on, that passkey is the only thing that can approve a change.

## 3. Connect

Your assistant connects to your site's tools. You approve the connection with the same passkey.

## 4. Keep it

Tell it what's new. It drafts, you approve, the page goes live.

data.title: For assistants
data.summary: Start at llms.txt. Everything an assistant needs is there.
data.body:
Read [llms.txt](https://get.porchsite.dev/llms.txt), then the [install guide](https://get.porchsite.dev/install.md). The current version and its file hashes are in [latest.json](https://get.porchsite.dev/latest.json).

After installing, connect to the site's tool server at `https://<site>/mcp` and call `site_state` first.

data.title: Install
data.summary: Tell your assistant: Set up Porchsite from porchsite.dev.
data.body:
That's the whole instruction. Your assistant will ask you to make a free Cloudflare account if you don't have one, and to let it in.

Tested with Grok and Claude. Others are being tested.
